profile_text.body:
Credo AI, founded in 2020, describes itself as the trusted leader in AI governance. The company's platform operationalizes governance across AI models, agents, and applications by helping enterprises discover their AI systems, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk. Credo AI positions itself as the creator of the AI governance category and states it is now defining governance for the agentic era.

The Credo AI platform is built around a Knowledge Graph that fuses global regulatory intelligence with business context. It offers model-level, application-level, and agent-level governance in a single system, with native integrations across existing stacks. The company provides ready-to-deploy policy packs for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001, written by personnel involved in creating these standards at the ISO, NIST, EU Parliament, NATO, and OECD. The platform includes GAIA (Govern AI Assistant), described as generally available, which the company says compresses weeks of governance work into hours. Credo AI also operates 300+ integrations and maintains a team of forward-deployed governance experts.
